annotated_by: hand-annotated from a domain reading of the source
annotation_notes: Same criteria as SP_TRANSFER_FUNDS: a rule constrains or defines what the
business permits. The three IF branches encode three distinct outcomes and
are therefore three rules, not one. The 365-day threshold is the business
policy; the UPDATE statements are its mechanical consequence.

rules.statement: An ACTIVE account with no customer-initiated transaction for more than 365 days must be marked DORMANT.
rules.subject: v_days_inactive

rules.statement: A DORMANT account that has transacted within the last 365 days must be reactivated to ACTIVE.
rules.subject: v_days_inactive

rules.statement: An account meeting neither the dormancy nor the reactivation condition keeps its current status.
rules.subject: p_result

rules.statement: A request for an account that does not exist must be reported as ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND.
rules.subject: p_result

rules.statement: Days inactive is measured from the last transaction date to the as-of date, treating a missing last-transaction date as effectively unlimited inactivity.
rules.subject: v_days_inactive
